texts.preamble: Assam vs The State Of Assam And 2 Ors on 22 June, 2022 Author: Manish Choudhury Bench: Manish Choudhury Page No.# 1/3 Gahc010121352022 The Gauhati High Court (High Court Of Assam, Nagaland, Mizoram And Arunachal Pradesh) Case No. : Wp(C)/4148/2022 M/S Mb Omm Guijan Ghat, Post Office- Rangagorah, Guijan, District- Tinsukia, Assam, Pin Code- 786147 Having Gst Registration No. 18Avwpd8621M1Zu And License No. 10317017000176 Issued Under Food Safety And Standards Act, 2006 By The Government Of Assam, Commissionerate Of Food Safety, Assam, Under Health And Family Welfare Department, Assam, A House Boat, Which Is A Proprietorial Concern Of Sri Prassanna Das, Aged About 62 Years, Son Of Late Parsuram Das, Resident Of Village- Guijan, Post Office- Rangagorah, Police Station- Tinsukia, District- Tinsukia (Assam). Versus The State Of Assam And 2 Ors Represented By The Commissioner And Secretary To The Government Of Assam, Tourism Department, Dispur, Guwahati- 781006. 2:The Assam Tourism Development Corporation Limited Asom Paryatan Bhawan (4Th Floor) A.K. Azad Road Paltan Bazar Guwahati- 781008 Represented By The Managing Director Assam Tourism Development Corporation Limited Asom Paryatan Bhawan (4Th Floor) A.K. Azad Road Paltan Bazar Guwahati- 781008. Assam vs The State Of Assam And 2 Ors on 22 June, 2022 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/75261605/ 1 3:The Managing Director Pa Assam Tourism Development Corporation Limited Asom Paryatan Bhawan (4Th Floor) A.K. Azad Road Paltan Bazar Guwahati- 781008 Advocate for the Petitioner : Mr. S Banik Advocate for the Respondent : Ga, Assam Before Honourable Mr. Justice Manish Choudhury Order
texts.facts: The petitioner has been operating a House Boat at Guijan Ghat, Tinsukia since the year 2015. The petitioner is aggrieved by the eligibility criteria of the bidder laid down in Clause 3[ii] of the bidding document whereby only those bidders who have experience in running a Registered Hotel/Guest House/Resort having restaurant or F & B services for minimum three years have been made eligible to submit the bids. The bidding document has further mentioned that the bidders who do not fulfill the requirements need not participate in the bid process.
texts.arguments: 4. It is the case of the petitioner that as per "the Rules for regulating grant of incentives to entrepreneur for promotion of tourism in the State of Assam", notified by the Government Page No.# 3/3 notification dated 22.06.1992, the definition 'Hotel' means and includes also house boats with or without boat suitable for accommodation of tourists, and approved by the Department of Tourism. The petitioner has contended that the definition of ' Hotel' containing house boats in the said rules of the notification meets the eligibility criteria of the bidder for the contract- work in question. However, house boat is not specifically indicated in the aforesaid Press Notice [QCBS] and thus, the petitioner seeking appropriate remedy has preferred this writ petition.
texts.petitioner_arguments: 4. It is the case of the petitioner that as per "the Rules for regulating grant of incentives to entrepreneur for promotion of tourism in the State of Assam", notified by the Government Page No.# 3/3 notification dated 22.06.1992, the definition 'Hotel' means and includes also house boats with or without boat suitable for accommodation of tourists, and approved by the Department of Tourism. The petitioner has contended that the definition of ' Hotel' containing house boats in the said rules of the notification meets the eligibility criteria of the bidder for the contract- work in question. However, house boat is not specifically indicated in the aforesaid Press Notice [QCBS] and thus, the petitioner seeking appropriate remedy has preferred this writ petition.
